title: Animating a Cube: Move, Rotate, Scale and Export to MP4
blurb: Keyframe a cube that slides, spins and grows, then render one MP4 video.

title: Tumbling Colour Cube Animation and MP4 Export
blurb: A cube tumbles on all three axes with a light that tracks it. Bonus: three colours on opposite faces.

title: 2D Bouncing Ball with a Squashed Bottom
blurb: Graph Editor, squash and stretch, a looping bounce, then sound effects and an explosion.

title: Jump and Fall: a Platformer
blurb: A character that runs, jumps, lands on platforms and falls off the edges. About one class period.

title: Pong
blurb: Draw sprites in Piskel, build a one-player Pong game, and play it on your phone. About two class periods.

title: Short Animation Assignment
blurb: Animate the default cube for 250 frames so it moves, rotates and changes size, then render and hand in an MP4.

title: Video Editing Basics in Blender 5.2
blurb: Cut several clips into one short video in Blender's Video Sequencer, add a title, transitions and music, and export an MP4.

title: Make a Fancy Column
blurb: Stretch a cube into a tall column, then shape it with loop cuts, scaling, moving and extruding.

title: Textures from Poly Haven: a Street Corner Made of Cubes
blurb: Build a road, sidewalk, brick wall and door from stretched cubes, then give each one a free Poly Haven texture with real bumps and depth.

title: Make a Soup Can
blurb: Model a soup can with tin ends, a wraparound label and raised metal rims, using inset, extrude, bevel and UV editing.

title: A Window Texture on Every Side of a Cube
blurb: A short first look at UVs: put one window picture on every side of a cube with no nodes, then reset the UVs so each side shows the whole window.

title: Texturing a 3×3×3 Apartment Cube
blurb: Cut a cube into a 3 × 3 grid on every side and turn it into a small apartment building with windows, a roofline, a door and a drain pipe, then export it to Unreal.

title: Making the d4 (4-Sided Die) with UV-Mapped Numbers
blurb: Build a d4 from a cone, unwrap it onto a printed number layout, give it a glossy red resin finish with solid white numbers, and round the edges.

title: Waving Canadian Flag
blurb: Build a Canadian flag that waves in the wind with cloth physics, texture it, and set it in front of a Remembrance Day backdrop. About one class period.

title: Separate the Wheels
blurb: Two wheels built as one object share one origin dot, so they can't spin on their own axles. Split them into separate objects and give each its own origin.

title: Sharp Turn Wedge Robot: Drive and Push
blurb: Bring the wedge robot from Blender into Unreal and program it in Blueprint so it drives like a tank, spins on the spot and pushes physics cubes.

title: Robot Sumo Ring Game
blurb: Model a sumo ring in Blender, bring it into Unreal, and turn the wedge robot into a game: reset when it drives off, bouncy balls that drop faster and faster, and a YOU LOSE! banner at 10 balls.

title: Rigging a Character
blurb: Build a skeleton (armature) for a Mixamo character, attach it with automatic weights, and add IK controls so the legs bend at the knee when you move the foot.

title: Shell Maker: Raup's Three Numbers in Geometry Nodes
blurb: Build one Geometry Nodes setup that grows a nautilus, an ammonite, a snail, a tower snail or a clam, by changing only three numbers.

title: Move a Cube with WASD
blurb: Your first Unreal Blueprint: a cube with a follow camera that drives around the level with W, A, S and D, using the built-in DefaultPawn. No Event Graph wiring.

title: Rolling Hills Grass Scene
blurb: Sculpt a landscape of rolling hills in Unreal, model a clump of grass in Blender, and let Unreal spread thousands of grass clumps over the hills automatically.

title: Bringing Fab Content into Unreal
blurb: Add free models and asset packs from Fab, Epic's asset store, to a Third Person project, place them at a sensible size, and make sure the character bumps into them.

title: Swap the Third Person Character for a Fab Character
blurb: Keep the Third Person player that already walks and jumps, give it a new body from Fab, then make it bigger or smaller. No code. About one class.

title: Mixamo Character to Unreal Game
blurb: Download a Mixamo character, import it into a Third Person project, retarget the walk and jump animations to it, and play as your own character.

title: Recording Gameplay and Rendering to MP4
blurb: Record yourself playing with Take Recorder, check the take, and render it to a clean 1080p MP4 with Movie Render Queue for Google Classroom.

title: Robot Sumo: Drive and Turn with Enhanced Input
blurb: Build a cube robot you drive like a tank, using Unreal's Enhanced Input system: Input Actions, an Input Mapping Context and a small Event Graph.

title: Move a Cube 5 m Left with C++
blurb: Your first C++ in Unreal: one line that makes a cube jump, then a timer that makes it hop, then a smooth 5 m slide at 1 m per second. Same lesson as the Unity C# version, so you can compare the two.

title: Move a Cube 5 m Left with C#
blurb: Your first C# program in Unity: one line that makes a cube jump, a loop that makes it hop, then a smooth 5 m slide at 1 m per second. Same lesson as the Unreal C++ version, so you can compare the two.

title: Drive the VR Robot 5 Squares: Blocks, Switch and Python
blurb: Make the VEX VR robot drive forward 5 grid squares three ways (Blocks, Switch and typed Python) and see how blocks turn into code. Runs in the browser.

title: Jumping Alien Sprite
blurb: Draw a one-eyed alien pixel by pixel, animate a 5-frame jump (stand, crouch, jump, top, land) and export a sprite sheet for Construct 3. One to two class periods.

title: Create a Snowman: Moving Around in Blender
blurb: Your first Blender lesson. Learn to zoom, spin and pan the view, add, delete, move and scale objects, then stack spheres into a snowman with a carrot nose.
